children: Exelixis announced the FDA extended the NDA review for zanzalintinib with atezolizumab by three months, setting a new PDUFA date of March 3, 2027.
FDA extended review of Exelixis' NDA for zanzalintinib plus atezolizumab by three months.
Extension follows Exelixis' submission of updated safety and efficacy data in response to an FDA information request.
FDA deemed the submission a major amendment, moving the PDUFA action date to March 3, 2027.
